watch.summary: The creator hype-celebrates a genius timing strategy suggested by chat, only to immediately fail and shout at chat for lying to him.

beats.what: Creator counts rhythmically trying to time his egg game movement based on chat advice.
Creator prematurely celebrates chat's strategy as a 'big brain' move.
Creator recalibrates his strategy and counts down to execute the movement.
He makes his move based on the timing and immediately falls to his demise.
Creator stands up from his chair in disbelief and yells 'Who lied to me?!'

watch.author: creator
watch.why: The premature hype over 'big brain' tactics sets up classic hubris. The sudden failure and explosive physical outrage at chat deliver a great comedy payoff.
